root_cause.text: The `gmap_helper_zap_one_page()` function lacks validation of the guest page state (PGSTE) before clearing swap page table entries (PTEs), causing it to unconditionally discard active swapped guest pages and lead to memory corruption.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows that the calls to `ptep_zap_softleaf_entry()` and `pte_clear()` are modified to only execute if the PGSTE value (`pgstev`) indicates the page is unused (`_PGSTE_GPS_USAGE_UNUSED`) or zero (`_PGSTE_GPS_ZERO`):

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a guard condition to ensure swap PTEs are only cleared when the guest page state is unused or zero.
intent_record.what: Introduced a conditional check on the PGSTE value (pgstev) to verify if the guest page state is unused (_PGSTE_GPS_USAGE_UNUSED) or zero (_PGSTE_GPS_ZERO) before zapping the softleaf entry and clearing the PTE.
intent_record.how: Restricts the clearing of swap PTEs and zapping of softleaf entries to only occur when the guest page status meets specific unused or zero criteria, preventing unintended clearing of active swap entries.
